newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares scale new heights, no fall foreseen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares scale new heights, no fall foreseen.

text.p: Danish share prices powered ahead to yet another record high on Monday and dealers expected further gains on Tuesday.
"We can expect a lot of buyers tomorrow, when we shall start at the same level and then rise over the course of the day," was one dealer's confident forecast.
The KFX top-20 index rose 0.37 point to 127.62 in overall bourse turnover of 770 million crowns.
It was the index's 10th closing high in the past 11 trading days.
The KFX December future rose 0.75 point to 128.00.
Despite the sagging Danish bond market, bank shares advanced, Den Danske Bank four crowns to 434 and Unidanmark three crowns to 289 crowns.
Dealers said that buyers, among the big institutional investors, showed interest in a range of shares both on and off the KFX.
Hi-tech startup Neurosearch was one of the more sought-after of the non-KFX shares, rising 11 crowns to 255 in turnover of almost 9,000 shares traded.
